This '''male Human''' was the son of [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Cagaran Wei]] who lived in [[Hweg Shul]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after his [[Cagaran Wei's wife|mother]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] accident, Wei's son went to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to study medicine.<ref name="conviction" />
